<!-- Release: v0.14.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Uses the same development signing key as earlier releases; install over your existing development build.

## Changes

- Arrange player actions in customizable slots, with drag/drop, layout choices, and clearer state icons
- Hold Repeat for advanced song-end and queue-end playback options
- Smoother player text and automatic scrolling, with aligned floating controls and clearer Rename icons

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/62 - Player action slots and direct drag customization
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/63 - Advanced Repeat popup and playback behavior
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/65 - Smooth player text scaling
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/66 - Automatic scrolling without correction passes
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/67 - Pencil icons for Rename
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/68 - Circular, aligned playlist add control

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.14.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it on Android and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Tap **Install** or **Update**. Keep the existing app installed to retain your library and settings.
